claim: ZaloPay Web to App is the primary gateway for automatic payment integration, using HMAC-SHA256 with Key1/Key2.
Webhook endpoints require an Idempotency check with Redis (txnId cache) to handle retry payloads safely.
Xu/Coins cannot be converted to cash, refunded, or traded to prevent illegal gambling or financial licensing violations.
Astro endpoints for billing must be placed in src/pages/api/billing/ to run serverless logic.
Database ledger writes must utilize Row-level locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE) to prevent race condition balance updates.
Daily aggregate invoicing via e-invoice API reduces bookkeeping overhead and invoice counts.
PayOS/VietQR is recommended for Phase 1 MVP to test payment flows without business license overhead.
